item.title: Kusatsu Onsen Manju: Steamed Buns Cooked with Hot Spring Vapour — Guide
item.description: Onsen manju, sweet steamed buns filled with red bean paste, are a beloved snack found across Japan’s hot spring towns, but Kusatsu’s version carries a particular local charm — traditionally, some shops cooked the buns using steam vented directly from the town’s natural hot springs rather than conventional kitchen equipment. Dozens of shops around the Yubatake sell warm, freshly steamed manju, each with slight variations in dough colour, sweetness, and bean paste texture, making a comparison tasting a popular activity for visitors strolling the town.
